Hi Michael,

Thanks again for setting up the demo for next week. Unfortunately, there's been a last-minute shift in our schedule: our leadership team decided to move the Acme Field Week site visits to Feb 22-23 and several stakeholders who were planning to attend the demo will be traveling on those dates.

Would it be possible to move the demo to one of the following windows instead?
- Wed, Feb 24 — 10:00am-11:00am PT
- Thu, Feb 25 — 2:00pm-3:00pm PT
- Mon, Mar 1 — morning (any time before 11:30am PT)

If none of those work, we can also do a shorter recorded walkthrough for those on travel and a live Q&A the following week.

I've attached the current invite for reference (acme-demo-invite.ics). Appreciate your flexibility — we're excited to see Redwood in action.

Thanks,

Proposed options (all PT):
- Wed, Feb 24 — 10:00am-11:00am PT (preferred)
- Thu, Feb 25 — 2:00pm-3:00pm PT

If you prefer the recorded walkthrough option, we can pre-record a 20-minute demo by Feb 23 and then schedule a 30-minute live Q&A the week of Mar 1. Sean (cc'd) can handle the recording and will include specific notes for your team.

Next steps:

Thanks — looking forward to it.
